title.vi: Dự án: bộ truy vấn KPI cho bảng điều khiển
title.en: Project: a KPI query set for a dashboard

summary.vi: người dùng mới, doanh thu, chuyển đổi, giữ chân, doanh thu trung bình trên người mua (ARPPU)
summary.en: new users, revenue, conversion, retention, average revenue per paying user (ARPPU)

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
-- KPI theo tháng: người dùng mới, người mua, doanh thu, ARPPU
WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM users GROUP BY month
),
sales AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyers, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM purchases GROUP BY month
)
SELECT s.month, n.new_users, s.buyers, s.revenue,
       ROUND(1.0 * s.revenue / s.buyers, 1) AS arppu
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN new_users n ON n.month = s.month
ORDER BY s.month
LIMIT 4;

prompt.vi: Dự án: trả về bảng KPI theo THÁNG cho 2023: month, new_users (số người đăng ký trong tháng), buyers (số người mua DISTINCT), revenue (tổng tiền) và arppu = ROUND(revenue / buyers, 1). Chỉ các tháng 2023 có đơn mua, sắp xếp theo month.
prompt.en: Project: return a KPI table by MONTH for 2023: month, new_users (signups that month), buyers (DISTINCT buyers), revenue (total amount) and arppu = ROUND(revenue / buyers, 1). Only 2023 months that have purchases, sorted by month.

hint.vi: Hai CTE (new_users, sales) rồi LEFT JOIN theo month và lọc month LIKE '2023%'.
hint.en: Two CTEs (new_users, sales) then LEFT JOIN on month and filter month LIKE '2023%'.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM users GROUP BY month;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM users GROUP BY month
),
sales AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyers, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM purchases GROUP BY month
)
SELECT s.month, n.new_users, s.buyers, s.revenue,
       ROUND(1.0 * s.revenue / s.buyers, 1) AS arppu
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN new_users n ON n.month = s.month
WHERE s.month LIKE '2023%'
ORDER BY s.month;

prompt.vi: KPI theo KÊNH: với mỗi channel trả về users, buyers (số người đã từng mua), conversion_pct = 100.0 * buyers / users làm tròn 1 chữ số, và revenue (tổng tiền, 0 nếu không có). Sắp xếp theo conversion_pct giảm dần rồi channel.
prompt.en: KPIs by CHANNEL: for each channel return users, buyers (users who ever purchased), conversion_pct = 100.0 * buyers / users rounded to 1 digit, and revenue (total amount, 0 if none). Sorted by conversion_pct descending then channel.

hint.vi: Tính theo người rồi gộp theo channel; COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0).
hint.en: Compute per user then aggregate by channel; COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0).

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS users FROM users GROUP BY channel;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.channel, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS revenue,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(p.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bought
  FROM users u LEFT JOIN purchases p ON p.user_id = u.id
  GROUP BY u.id, u.channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(bought) AS buyers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(bought) / COUNT(*), 1) AS conversion_pct,
       SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM per_user
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY conversion_pct DESC, channel;
